title: Create:To The Skies
description: A Lightweight Modpack built around Create: Aeronautics
body:
Create: To the Skies is a lightweight modpack built around [Create: Aeronautics](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics).

It incourages Exploration, Creativity, and Community via mods such as [Terralith](https://modrinth.com/datapack/terralith), [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create), and [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-voice-chat).
The modpack is designed for a Multiplayer setting however thats not stopping you from playing singleplayer! There's no endgoal set for you, so the skies the limit!
